---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new page, section, or capability
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What you'd like

A clear, one-sentence description of the feature.

## Why

What problem does this solve? Who benefits — first-time visitors, regulars, the pastoral team, the admin? Pretend you're pitching it to someone who isn't familiar with the site.

## What you imagine

A rough sketch of what the feature looks like. A few bullets of behaviour is enough — wireframes / mockups are welcome but not required.

- Where does this live (which page / section)?
- What does the visitor interact with?
- What happens when they do?

## Alternatives considered

Other ways this could be solved. Maybe a smaller version of the same idea, or a different surface altogether.

## Priority

- [ ] Critical — blocking a launch or causing pastoral issues
- [ ] High — would meaningfully improve the visitor experience
- [ ] Medium — nice to have within the next quarter
- [ ] Low — wishlist, no urgency

## Anything else

Links to other church sites that do this well, references, screenshots — anything that helps the implementer.
